title: Rerun the PCSX2 setup wizard from a copied launcher
summary: Use `-setupwizard` to force the documented initial setup wizard, while preserving a backup and the ordinary shortcut for a safe comparison.
heroAlt: Front right view of a slim PlayStation 2 console.
author: EmuCore - Hub
searchKeywords: rerun the pcsx2 setup wizard without losing your profile
Rerun the PCSX2 setup wizard from a copied launcher

blocks.text: Use the wizard for a specific setup task

PCSX2’s CLI reference says `-setupwizard` forces the initial setup wizard to run. This is useful when you intentionally need to revisit first-run choices, but it is not a general fix for a game crash. Preserve your current configuration so you can compare the wizard’s result and restore it if needed.

Close PCSX2 and locate the exact data directory used by the launcher. Back up its configuration before starting. If the goal is to choose a BIOS, use only a firmware dump made from your own console; do not obtain BIOS files from download sites. Leave memory-card saves and game images in their usual locations.

items: 1. Confirm the normal PCSX2 launcher opens the profile you intend to update.
2. Close the application and make a restorable copy of that profile’s configuration directory.
3. Copy the launcher command and preserve its executable and `-portable` or `-datapath` arguments.
4. Add `-setupwizard` to the copied command and start it once.
5. Review the wizard choices carefully; point it to your own BIOS dump and existing game library only where appropriate.
6. Finish or cancel the wizard, then start PCSX2 normally without `-setupwizard` and inspect the result.

blocks.text: The procedure passes if the wizard opens from the copied command and the ordinary launcher still opens the expected profile afterward. Verify the BIOS selection and controller/library paths inside settings; never infer they are correct from the wizard closing successfully.

items: Wizard does not appear: check the copied executable and confirm the switch is spelled `-setupwizard`.
Wrong profile is edited: compare the data directory and restore the backup if needed.
No BIOS is listed: check your own firmware dump and configuration path; do not download a replacement.
Existing game list looks empty: verify its library path before refreshing or rescanning.

blocks.text: Close PCSX2, remove `-setupwizard` from the copied command, and restore the configuration backup if settings or paths changed unexpectedly. Reopen through the original shortcut and verify saves and library locations before resuming play.
